h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhalswa Jahangir Pur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhalswa Jahangir Pur

items.pText: Bhalswa Jahangir Pur is a densely built neighbourhood in north-west Delhi, near Bhalswa Lake. Open spaces here are few and heavily used, so a small park may see hundreds of children over a week. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for parks, schools and community spaces in this part of Delhi. We make it at our Vasai factory, about 1,130 km away, and install it with our team or a dealer.

Heavy use changes how you choose equipment. Pieces with many small moving parts need more attention than simple, solid ones, and a crowded park benefits from equipment several children can use together. Delhi's weather adds pressure too, with hot summers, dust, a short monsoon and cold, smoggy winters. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic hold up through all of it. We suggest a layout that keeps clear paths, so children running between pieces do not collide.

items.q: What playground equipment suits a crowded public park?
items.a: Solid pieces that several children use together, such as multi see-saws, climbers and wide slides. They need fewer checks than equipment with many moving parts and keep more children busy at once.

items.q: Should posts be grouted in a busy park?
items.a: Yes. In a heavily used park we recommend grouting every post into a concrete base. It keeps the equipment firm and stops it shifting over time.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in north-west Delhi?
items.a: Yes. We send the equipment from Vasai by road and install it with our team or a dealer serving Delhi.
